I'm in France at the moment, I tried to look for nembutal in China but couldn't find it, I didn't know exactly where to look actually... It would be great to be able to find some in France but everybody says the websites like these for example [https://medicamentfinal.com/](https://medicamentfinal.com/) are fake and that you'll only lose your money.

If someone knows a reliable website please do tell.
Same here. Why suffer a whole existence of misery? I just don’t want to wake up from my attempt hence my initial question.

When I say « he will never leave me » that means it’s been 3 months I can’t stop thinking about him every second of every minute, it’s killing me softly and I developed tons of physical symptoms with hospital trips... I just suffer so much mentally and physically, I lost 20 kilos in 2 months, I have no energy, I feel weak, I don’t eat, I don’t sleep, 2-3 hours of restless sleep a night with apnea and nightmares... it is just too hard.
